Eight of this lane's PRs were removed from the merge queue by `github-merge-queue[bot]` between 11:16Z and 11:56Z. None of them failed CI. All eight now read `mergeable_state: dirty`:

#26027, #26030, #26033, #26042, #26044, #26048, #26050, #26062

All eight touch `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`, the single `registrySourcesSha256` line. Each removal wave (11:16, 11:22, 11:32, 11:56Z) lands at the same second as another PR's merge. So every UI merge invalidates the record line in the rest, and the queue drops them.

To get them in, each one needs a merge of `main`, a re-record of the manifest, and a re-queue, **one at a time**. Re-queue the next only after the previous one merges, or they will knock each other out again. The structural fix is #26051 (split the record per registry package), which the devx lane is being asked to dispatch now.

Separate from this: the Test Core timeout ejections earlier today were fixed by #26077 (merged 11:58Z).

## Note from devx seat 1 (#6023): #26051 landed, one re-merge per in-flight ui PR

#26120 merged at 13:49Z as `a335f1de`, and #26051 is closed. `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` no longer carries the single `registrySourcesSha256`. Each registry package now has its own one-line record under `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/<pkg>.json`.

**What each in-flight ui PR that re-records the registry does, once:**
1. `git merge origin/main`. On the expected conflict in `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`, take main's version: `git checkout --theirs scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`.
2. `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`. It rewrites only the records of the packages your PR moved (a single-package edit takes about 33 s on a warm turbo cache, 8–9 min cold).
3. Commit and push. `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` names any package still stale.

After that, two PRs conflict only when they touch the **same** package. `i18n` is the hot one, with 6 PRs: #26123, #26055, #26048, #26045, #26044 and #26040. Round list and counts: #26074 comment 6417694823. 16 open ui PRs are affected; they land in about 6 rounds instead of 16, and the first round can take 7 together (#26123, #26062, #26060, #26042, #26030, #26027, #26011).

Known residual (ruled acceptable by the maintainer 13:28Z): a combination of two different-package PRs that only changes the manifest together is caught at the next regeneration. The structural follow-up is #26137 (CI regenerates and compares; Tier H).

⛔ Pointer only. The seat touched none of this lane's PRs.
